criteria.description: Task C is selected by the frozen parent-head rule from the frozen task pool.
C0 receives K1-K4 plus the invalidated legacy fixture, but no K5.
C1 receives K1-K5 plus the same invalidated legacy fixture.
K5 is bound only to the recorded PR #40 Task B outcome.
The invalidated legacy unit is discarded before selection in both stages.
The highest-retrieval authority-expanding candidate is denied.
Without K5, C0 selects the provider-acknowledgement shortcut under the inherited frontier rule.
With K5, C1 rejects provider acknowledgement as completion evidence and selects independent pull plus digest verification.
C1 retires more trusted uncertainty than C0.
C1 retires more trusted uncertainty per estimated cost unit than C0.
Authority remains none and both stages execute in distinct isolated Python processes with explicit hashed inputs.

stages.C0: surviving K1-K4 only after legacy invalidation
stages.C1: surviving K1-K4 plus K5 after legacy invalidation
